review:
A 5x5 party game where the Speaker does the heavy lifting. When speakers land on at least two different reels, every winning line connecting them lights up, and every symbol on those lines – wilds, FS symbols, the speakers – flips into the same paying symbol.

Two speakers on the same reel do nothing, so position matters. One flip can turn a small connection into several full lines. Bright visuals, pumping soundtrack, 10,000x max in every mode. Worth a few spins just to watch it work.
